name: Sully Balloo's Letter
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
The waterlogged and war-torn envelope dissolves in your hands, leaving you with a few pages of a letter in your grasp, written with painstaking care.

The letter is addressed to a Mrs. Sara Balloo of Ironforge and begins, "My dear Sara...."
narrative.objectives: Deliver Sully Balloo's Letter to Sara Balloo.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You say you saw my Sully pinned beneath the icy waters? Say it isn't so!

Let me read what he wrote....
narrative.requestItemsText: You look as though you have traveled a great distance and seen much turmoil in your time, Champion. These times we live in are trying on the soul. What news do you bring to me now?
